extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank used for?
faqs.a: A mud tank stores and transports drilling mud. This skid-mounted 500 BBL tank sits within a 40-ft ISO seafreight container footprint, which avoids oversize-shipping surcharges, and is designed for variable mud density.

faqs.q: What size is the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank?
faqs.a: The tank has a 500 BBL capacity inside a 40-ft ISO container footprint. An open-top multi-compartment treatment-tank variant is available for cuttings and recycled mud handling.

faqs.q: What lines and fittings does the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank have?
faqs.a: Fill, recirculation, discharge and drain lines are standard, with liquid-level sight gauges. Dual manholes, one on top and one on the side, allow cross-ventilation for safe inspector entry.

faqs.q: Why does the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank have two manholes?
faqs.a: The top and side manholes allow cross-ventilation so an inspector can enter the tank safely. Follow the site confined-space entry procedure before anyone enters.

faqs.q: What fluid density can the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank handle?
faqs.a: It is designed for variable mud density, so it can store drilling muds of different weights. State the heaviest mud density on the RFQ so the shell and supports are checked.

faqs.q: How is the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank shipped?
faqs.a: It is skid-mounted within the 40-ft ISO seafreight footprint, so it ships as standard container freight without oversize surcharges. An axle-mounted, road-registered variant is also available.

faqs.q: What connects to the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank?
faqs.a: It connects to the mud pumps, the degasser and the liquid mud plant through the fill, recirculation and discharge lines. See [mud pump packages](/c/dw-mud-pump-package), [mud degassers](/c/dw-mud-degasser) and [liquid mud plants](/c/dw-liquid-mud-plant).

faqs.q: How does the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank differ from a workover tank?
faqs.a: The mud tank is a drilling mud storage and transport vessel in a 40-ft container footprint, while the [insulated workover tank](/p/workover-tank-240-bbl-brine-service-insulated-manholes-recirc-manifold) is built for brine and mud service in workovers. Choose by service and volume.

faqs.q: Where is the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank used?
faqs.a: It is used on drilling rigs for mud storage and transport, and the open-top variant handles cuttings and recycled mud. See the guide on [cementing and drilling-fluid equipment](/blog/cementing-and-drilling-fluid-equipment).

faqs.q: What should I send for a mud tank quotation?
faqs.a: Send the volume, the mud density range, the number of compartments, the mounting (skid or axle) and the delivery site. The treatment-tank variant is quoted separately.

faqs.q: Is an axle-mounted version of the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank available?
faqs.a: Yes, an axle-mounted, road-registered variant is available. State whether the tank must move by road between sites on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 500 BBL skid-mounted mud tank as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send your capacity, configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
